methodology: Activation-only ring64 protocols. Inputs are bounded public fixtures privately shared; only final outputs are opened. Live runs draw fresh masks. Integer intervals cover all floor/ceil rounding choices and verify accumulator bounds below 2**62. Isolated-party transcript replay checks exact output and outgoing messages; phase estimates exclude network latency and bandwidth.
